cut_analysis.cut_scope: Cuts precede the observed first-layer normalization kernels. A boundary kernel can fuse preceding-pass normalization and next-pass input work. These cuts are not exact Python recurrent-pass completion timestamps.

topology.cut_scope: Cuts precede the observed first-layer normalization kernels. A boundary kernel can fuse preceding-pass normalization and next-pass input work. These cuts are not exact Python recurrent-pass completion timestamps.
topology.dependency_scope: Captured execution order only. A stream edge can be stronger than a mathematical data dependency.
topology.recurrence_scope: Repeated kernels do not imply reusable activation values or independent recurrent passes.
topology.timing: NOT_MEASURED. Node counts and edges do not determine kernel duration.

mutation: NONE. No event nodes, dependency changes, or PDL settings.

snapshot.scope: Top-level raw-graph metadata only. No recursive child-graph query.
